# Before you leave

Busy is not the same as active. Claude's synthesized clicks and typing do not reset the Windows idle timer, so the 40-minute run counts as 40 minutes of idle.
**The catch:** input from computer use never resets the OS idle timer, so clicking the whole time won't keep the screensaver away.

| Hazard | Why |
|---|---|
| Screensaver | Synthesized input doesn't reset the idle timer |
Windows doesn't count Claude's clicks as activity.
